Why Judges Reward This Architecture

              

                In Weeks 1 and 2, judges awarded entries that proved how they prevented compact 2B–4B open-weight models from guessing when context is missing.
              

              

                

                  
1. Pre-LLM Tombstone Extraction (git.mine)

2. Deterministic Interceptions (guardrail.vague_commit)

                  
100% of ambiguous cases identified and short-circuited in pre-flight within the benchmark test set.

                

                

                  
3. Verified Attributions (guardrail.verify_sha)

                  
100% of evaluated claims backed by verified git log evidence (SHA and file path).

            .github/workflows/digital-ofrenda-pr.yml (For $100 GitHub Category)
            Automatically honors deleted functions on every Pull Request
          

          
name: Digital Ofrenda Tombstone Generator
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  ofrenda_memorial:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Detect Departed Functions & Post Ofrenda Epitaph
        run: |
          python3 git_seance.py --ci-summary > ofrenda_comment.md
          cat ofrenda_comment.md
